about: The one machine-readable list of this repository's Rust workspaces.
This repo is deliberately not a Cargo workspace; the reasoning and what
devenv.nix, nix/hooks/lib.ts and nix/check-crates.ts read this file, so
a new crate is one entry here, not a list typed in five places.
path    the directory holding the crate's Cargo.toml and Cargo.lock
fmt     cargo fmt and clippy cover it (devenv's `fmt`/`lint`, the
fmtAll  cargo fmt needs --all (a virtual workspace with no package
at its root finds no targets otherwise)
test    its suite runs in `test-rust` and pre-push's test:<crate>; a
fmt-only crate is linted with the others but its tests are

crates.why: lososd, the control plane, and losos-ctl, its command half. Depends on access, edge-path and several plugins by path.

The terminal envelope (OpenPGP, tokens) that backend, edge/registrar and admin-ui/tui all depend on by path, and LosOS Desktop reads by git. Its own workspace so `cargo fmt` of either parent does not reach it.
lososd's edge path rule, which LosOS Desktop's network machine reads by git too. Its own workspace for the same reason as the envelope.

MDX and Markdown to sanitized HTML (backend/mdx/README.md), shared by LosOS Office and Notes and built for the browser through wasm-bindgen; `lint-wasm` lints the wasm32 build with the `wasm` feature.
lososd's plugins (backend/plugins/README.md): the SDK and one crate per area, natively here; backend's tests build them for wasm32 to run the daemon. A virtual workspace, so `cargo fmt` needs --all.
The master-proxy registrar: orders, the market, gateway passports.
The Vercel host for the registrar (edge/vercel/README.md). Not built by nix — Vercel builds it — but linted and tested with the other crates.
The Solana escrow program. Linted with the others; its suite runs the program `cargo build-sbf` makes, so it is `test-solana-escrow`'s, not test-rust's.
LosOS Lab's core (admin-ui/lab/core/README.md), compiled to wasm for the Lab page.
The Lab's libvirt client, wasm too. Its live tests need a running libvirt daemon and are skipped unless LOSOS_VIRT_SOCK or LOSOS_VIRT_TCP is set.
The Lab's GPU canvas (admin-ui/lab/render/README.md). Bevy is a wasm32-only dependency, so this lints and tests its plain Rust; `lint-wasm` lints the two wasm32 builds.
losos, the terminal client (admin-ui/tui/README.md). Its suite runs a mock box and edge over TLS and, where util-linux `script` exists, the built binary in a pseudo-terminal.
